tests.name: u8string_to_json_basic
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string converts to a JSON string type.

tests.name: u8string_from_json_string
tests.intent: Verify that a JSON string can be read into a std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_from_json_array_fallback
tests.intent: Verify that legacy JSON array of code units can still be read into std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_from_json_invalid_type
tests.intent: Verify that reading a non-string/non-array JSON type into std::u8string throws type_error.

tests.name: u8string_embedded_nul
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string containing embedded NUL characters round-trips correctly through JSON string.

tests.name: u8string_in_container
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string nested inside a std::vector serializes as strings instead of arrays.

tests.name: u8string_in_map_key
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string can be used as a map key via standard conversions.

tests.name: u8string_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify std::u8string behavior with ordered_json containers.

tests.name: u8string_view_unchanged
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string_view still produces an array of code units as before.

tests.name: char8_array_unchanged
tests.intent: Verify that raw char8_t arrays still produce arrays of code units.

tests.name: u8string_large_resize
tests.intent: Verify large std::u8string conversions relying on the resize/direct-indexing optimization path.

tests.name: u8string_optional_support
tests.intent: Verify std::optional containing std::u8string converts properly to a JSON string or null.

tests.name: u8string_pair_tuple
tests.intent: Verify std::pair and std::tuple containing std::u8string serialize to JSON strings correctly.

tests.name: u8string_const_pointer
tests.intent: Verify const char8_t* behavior versus std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_empty_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that an empty std::u8string correctly serializes to an empty JSON string and back.

tests.name: u8string_to_json_pointer_access
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer lookup with values stored via std::u8string keys or values.

tests.name: u8string_patch_test
tests.intent: Verify JSON patch application involving std::u8string values.

tests.name: u8string_merge_patch_test
tests.intent: Verify JSON merge patch handling of std::u8string values.

tests.name: u8string_sax_consumer
tests.intent: Verify SAX interface behavior when parsing data containing string types compatible with conversions.

tests.name: u8string_custom_allocator
tests.intent: Verify std::u8string with custom allocators converts correctly to and from JSON.

tests.name: u8string_patch_test_fixed
tests.intent: Verify JSON patch application involving std::u8string values.
